text: Bilbo sets out from Bag End with Thorin and Company.
The Company encounters three trolls in the Trollshaws.
The Company arrives in Rivendell. Elrond reads the moon-letters.
The Company departs from Rivendell.
Captured by Goblins in the High Pass. Bilbo finds the One Ring.
Rescued by the Eagles. The Company reaches Beorn's Hall.
The Company enters Mirkwood forest.
Bilbo rescues the Dwarves from the Elvenking of Mirkwood.
The Company escapes in barrels down the Forest River.
The Company arrives at Lake-town. The Master receives them.
The Company departs Lake-town for the Lonely Mountain.
The Company reaches the Lonely Mountain. Smaug is roused.
The Battle of Five Armies. Smaug is slain. The quest is complete.
Frodo sets out from Bag End in the evening.
The hobbits cross the Bucklebury Ferry into Buckland.
Frodo and companions arrive at Bree and meet Strider at the Prancing Pony.
The company camps on Weathertop. Frodo is stabbed by the Witch-king.
Frodo rides for the Ford. The Ringwraiths are swept away by the Bruinen.
Frodo arrives in Rivendell. The Council of Elrond is convened.
The Fellowship of the Ring departs Rivendell at dusk.
The Fellowship attempts Caradhras and is turned back by storm.
The Fellowship enters the Mines of Moria through the West Gate.
Gandalf falls on the Bridge of Khazad-dum. The Fellowship escapes into Lothlorien.
The Fellowship departs Lothlorien by boat down the Silverlode.
The boats pass onto the Great River Anduin.
The Fellowship passes the Argonath and reaches Nen Hithoel.
The Breaking of the Fellowship. Frodo and Sam continue alone towards Mordor.
Frodo and Sam encounter Gollum, who becomes their guide.
Frodo looks upon the Black Gate and turns aside towards Cirith Ungol.
Frodo and Sam are brought before Faramir at Henneth Annun.
Frodo is stung by Shelob. Sam takes the Ring and presses on alone.
Frodo and Sam reach the slopes of Mount Doom.
Gollum seizes the Ring and falls into the Crack of Doom. Sauron is ended.
The Fellowship breaks. Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli pursue the Orcs across Rohan.
Aragorn meets Gandalf the White in Fangorn. The White Rider lives.
Gandalf releases Theoden from Saruman's spell. The king rides to war.
The Battle of the Hornburg. Aragorn holds the fortress until dawn.
Victory at Isengard. The Ents have broken the walls. Saruman is overthrown.
Aragorn takes the Paths of the Dead and summons the Dead Men of Dunharrow.
The fleet of Umbar is captured at Pelargir. The Dead fulfil their oath and are released.
The Battle of the Pelennor Fields. Aragorn arrives at the last hour and the city is saved.
The Host of the West marches to the Black Gate. The Ring is destroyed. Sauron passes away.
